items.title: "Dou-gong" Technique: A Novel Biomechanical Approach to Injection Rhinoplasty Based on Nasal Ligament Anatomy
items.fact_zh: 100例回顾：以鼻韧带为支点、骨膜上注射透明质酸，分五区，无血管栓塞。
items.take_zh: 把注射从堆量改成撑韧带，方向对；但100例无对照、无客观测量，只能算可行。
items.scene_zh: 想打针又怕变假鼻子的，先看他韧带松不松，不是先算毫升。
items.fact_en: In a 100-patient retrospective series, a five-zone "Dou-gong" technique injected hyaluronic acid above periosteum or perichondrium to reinforce nasal ligament support, with no vascular occlusion or material displacement.
items.take_en: Shifting injection rhinoplasty from volume stacking to ligament support is conceptually right, but a single-arm Level IV series without objective measurement proves feasibility only.

items.title: Integrated Perioperative Infection Management Measures (PSMS-11) for ePTFE Rhinoplasty in East Asian Patients: A Large-Sample, Long-Term Retrospective Study
items.fact_zh: 1153例ePTFE鼻整形：感染率1.6%，过半发生在术后6个月以后，含1年以上迟发。
items.take_zh: 感染不看前三个月就漏一半；抽烟、翻修、皮肤炎症是术前能改的变量。
items.scene_zh: 做ePTFE的病人半年后红肿发热，别当感冒治，先想到假体。
items.fact_en: Among 1,153 consecutive ePTFE rhinoplasties, overall infection incidence was about 1.6%, and more than half of infections presented beyond six months, including cases after one year.
items.take_en: Late-onset infection is common rather than exceptional, so follow-up must extend past the first year and modifiable risks such as smoking and revision belong in preoperative planning.

items.title: Compromised nasal skin in functional rhinoplasty: a literature review and proposal of a clinical management protocol
items.fact_zh: 综述：鼻皮肤坏死主因是翻修、吸烟、皮瓣过度打薄；早期硝酸甘油、高压氧、己酮可可碱可救。
items.take_zh: 真正该背的是风险清单和早期识别；等皮肤发黑再上药，多半只剩清创。
items.scene_zh: 抽烟又要翻修的，术前把皮肤风险讲透，别等拆线才解释。
items.fact_en: A review identified revision surgery, smoking and aggressive flap thinning as the main risk factors for nasal skin necrosis, with early topical nitroglycerin, hyperbaric oxygen and pentoxifylline suggested for salvage.
items.take_en: The protocol's value lies in preoperative risk stratification and early recognition; salvage drugs started after the skin turns black rarely change the outcome.

items.title: A Composite Internal Stabilization Strategy associated with Absence of Postoperative Hematoma After Facelift: A 561-Patient Comparative Series
items.fact_zh: 561例拉皮：内部止血网加渐进张力缝合，不放引流不加压，血肿清创0例，对照5.9%。
items.take_zh: 降到0靠的是消灭死腔不是压迫包扎；但面神经暂时麻痹10.4%，签字前得说。
items.scene_zh: 怕血肿又不想缠头绷带的，可以谈这做法，下颌缘麻痹要提前交代。
items.fact_en: In a 561-patient comparative series, an internal hemostatic network with progressive tension sutures and no drains or compression produced zero hematomas requiring evacuation versus 5.9% in controls, with transient marginal mandibular weakness in 10.4%.
items.take_en: Eliminating dead space beats external pressure for hematoma prevention, but a 10.4% transient nerve weakness rate is the price and belongs in consent.

items.title: When Does Grade I Ptosis Require Mastopexy? Implant-Only Augmentation in 198 Patients: A Clinical Framework for Patient Selection
items.fact_zh: 198例Ⅰ度下垂只放假体：翻修2例（1.0%），仅1人后来加做提乳，无包膜挛缩。
items.take_zh: Ⅰ度下垂不是提乳的自动指征；腺体量和组织厚度，比测量数据更能决定加不加疤。
items.scene_zh: 病人说不想多两道疤，我先捏组织厚度，再谈能不能只放假体。
items.fact_en: Of 198 women with Grade I ptosis selected for dual-plane augmentation alone, 1.0% were revised for superior malposition, one later chose mastopexy and none developed contracture.
items.take_en: Grade I ptosis is not an automatic mastopexy indication; glandular volume, tissue quality and expectation alignment decide whether extra scars are justified.

items.title: Breast Implant Flipping: Prevalence, Clinical Correlation, and Independent Risk Factors in a Consecutive Ultrasound Cohort
items.fact_zh: 590例超声筛查：假体翻转12.7%，大体积、胸肌前、缺软组织覆盖是独立风险。
items.take_zh: 八个人里一个翻转，多数没症状；随访加个超声，比追问手感靠谱。
items.scene_zh: 病人说一边摸着不对劲，先扫超声看补片朝哪边，别急着说没事。
items.fact_en: In 590 consecutive patients screened with high-resolution ultrasound, implant flipping was found in 12.7%, independently associated with larger volume, prepectoral placement and lack of soft tissue support.
items.take_en: One in eight implants is flipped, often silently; in-office ultrasound turns a vague complaint into an objective finding and belongs in routine follow-up.
